richiami.difetto: It has been identified that a combination of inaccurate machining and inconsistent quality of material can result in breakage of the radius handlebar post. Should this occur the rider may fall from the machine.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled machines will be checked to ascertain whether or not they fall within the affected batch. Should this be the case the subject component will be replaced.
